understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level (currently BP35) without dying, and continue completing subsequent levels until the game is won, using no more than 2 attempts per level and 50 turns per attempt.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose one action (e.g., MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN). The player moves one tile in that direction if possible. After movement, gravity applies in the current gravity direction (e.g., DOWN), causing the player to fall/slide until blocked by solid tiles; the HUD reports the current gravity and remaining turns/steps. Landing on a spike tile is a hazard that immediately ends the attempt/run. Levels allow 2 attempts; on failure the level restarts and the failure is added to recent context. Undo (when available) would revert the last action/state to a prior turn, allowing correction of mistakes; clicks would be used to activate level elements (like switches/tiles) by selecting a target tile/position to interact with, potentially changing the map or gravity.
